g.text: Title: Ioniq 5 Parking Safety auto-disable: ESP32-C3 add-on

g.desc: Title: Ioniq 5 Parking Safety auto-disable: ESP32-C3 add-on

g.text: Taps CON1 of the console switch panel PCB IP-678A

g.desc: Taps CON1 of the console switch panel PCB IP-678A

g.text: BTN = CON1-5 (Parking Safety switch line), 12.2 V idle in the car

g.desc: BTN = CON1-5 (Parking Safety switch line), 12.2 V idle in the car

g.text: 1. BTN = CON1-5, Parking Safety switch (~200R to GND in the panel), 12.2 V idle. Q1 + R3 emulate a press (in car: GPIO3 ~2.5 V released, ~0.1 V pressed).

g.desc: 1. BTN = CON1-5, Parking Safety switch (~200R to GND in the panel), 12.2 V idle. Q1 + R3 emulate a press (in car: GPIO3 ~2.5 V released, ~0.1 V pressed).

g.text: 2. CAN is silent by default: R6 holds S high and firmware keeps it high (listen-only). No 120R termination on this board.

g.desc: 2. CAN is silent by default: R6 holds S high and firmware keeps it high (listen-only). No 120R termination on this board.

g.text: 3. GPIO2/8/9 are strapping pins, held high by R11/R10/R9 (BOOT pulls GPIO9 low). D3 on GPIO1 is the board LED.

g.desc: 3. GPIO2/8/9 are strapping pins, held high by R11/R10/R9 (BOOT pulls GPIO9 low). D3 on GPIO1 is the board LED.

g.text: 4. Every part has an LCSC field for JLC assembly.

g.desc: 4. Every part has an LCSC field for JLC assembly.

g.text: 2.5 mm NPTH. H1/H2 on the Hammond 1551K PCB bosses (#2 x 3/16" self-tapping); H3/H4 bench only.

g.desc: 2.5 mm NPTH. H1/H2 on the Hammond 1551K PCB bosses (#2 x 3/16" self-tapping); H3/H4 bench only.

g.text: Bench flashing: 5V, D-, D+, GND on TP1-TP4

g.desc: Bench flashing: 5V, D-, D+, GND on TP1-TP4

g.text: Hold BOOT, tap RESET: ROM bootloader.

g.desc: Hold BOOT, tap RESET: ROM bootloader.
